_about: Licence texts for redistributed components whose packages ship no licence file. Every text is the vendor's or the upstream repository's own file, stored verbatim in license-texts/ and checked against sha256 each time notices are generated. An entry applies only to the exact crate version it was verified for: a different version has to be reviewed again. Nothing here is written by hand and no copyright line is invented.

sources.verification: The repository file at the commit recorded in the published crate (.cargo_vcs_info.json). The crate declares BSD-3-Clause.

The repository LICENSE at the commits recorded in the three published crates (edc2caf8... for webview2-com and webview2-com-sys, dffa41a8... for webview2-com-macros); the file is byte-identical at both. The crates declare MIT.
